title: ID0371689-DC/Si-D/RO[170000128] - Failed charging sessions
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
tried to charge DC multiple times, but every time it failed after approximately 3 minutes.
Root cause:
OCPP disconnections → WAN Failover ON
Solution:
Disable WAN Wired Failover and Force LTE connection
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: ID0371689-DC/Si-D/RO[170000128] - Failed charging sessions CRM:00315001653
additional_info.body:
Hi Traian, good morning. I hope you are doing fine today.
I just accessed the charger remotely and found that the WAN failover was turned ON. I believe this shouldn't be turned ON but please confirm this.
I also recommend to "Force LTE" which forces the connection to be 4G
Also the connection looks good.
Let me know your thoughts. I will remove WAN Failover for now.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0371689-DC/Si-D/RO[170000128] - Failed charging sessions CRM:00315001653
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
Thank you for your response.
Can you modify the settings as suggested (force LTE and Failover disable) or do I need to go there?
Thank you
-Traian

additional_info.subject: ID0371689-DC/Si-D/RO[170000128] - Failed charging sessions CRM:00315001653
additional_info.body:
Hi Traian,
Of course there is no need for you to do anything. I already performed this change, if you ever find yourself with OCPP connection issues you can reach out to me directly and I can check these settings again.
It's somewhat known that after a reboot, sometimes the OCPP router's WAN Failover is re-enabled. It's already in progress an implementation of log traces of these specific configurations. No ETA yet.
If you allow me, since the error has been found and resolved for now, I will close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
